a5486:
# home-viewer: the home base's middle (a5398). Press a pin, or choose a result in the bar's search (home-search, a6642), and it opens here, on the left
# of JEFF's chat (a5949, Alex 16 Oct: 'I want it open on the left side of this chat'); since a5994's equal footing it is
# a panel of its own (lens home-viewer in a panel note) and the chat another (jeff-chat): × closes it (unview)
# and Back goes one step. What is open is the viewer's own note (role=home-view, actor=$me): viewing= the thing, back=
# the one before, find= the words in the bar's search (home-search), pins= ids with commas, with= a lens to stand on the thing.
# Any lens opens here (a5949; Sable's a4270, a lens stood on a thing): with=<lens> draws the thing with that lens (Open
# with, or type a lens's name); a lens itself, opened here, runs (the dock's Writing opens the lens writing). Otherwise
# a document is drawn by doc-page (its words, comments and Talk); each other kind by its own lens, home-<kind>
# (home-note, home-chat, home-surface); anything else gets the plain card below.
# JEFF may set viewing= only when Alex asked to be shown something.
viewer : column
  share 1
  role viewer
  mine : column
    share 1
    of prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me as v
    each view
  lost : text "No viewer of yours here: a note in Home base with role=home-view actor=<you>."
    role hint
    only when count(prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me) = 0
view : column
  share 1
  role viewer
  let open = "yes" when ($v.viewing or "") != "" and $v.viewing != "a5080"
  let open = "no" otherwise
  bar : row
    role pins
    pins : row
      role pins
      share 1
      only when ($v.pins or "") != ""
      of $v.pins as p
      each pin
    gap : column
      share 1
      only when ($v.pins or "") = ""
    back : text "Back"
      role chip
      only when ($v.back or "") != ""
      on click do prop $v viewing="$v.back" back="$v.viewing" with=""
  split : row
    share 1
    gap
    left : column
      share 3
      only when open = "yes"
      open : column
        share 1
        of $v.viewing as r
        each shown
    nothing : text "Nothing open. Find it at the top, press a pin, or a name anywhere."
      role hint
      only when open = "no"
pin : text "$title"
  role chip
  role chip.on when $item = $v.viewing
  clamp 1
  on click do prop $v viewing=$p back="$v.viewing" find="" with=""
shown : column
  share 1
  role shown
  let islens = "yes" when ($tags or "") has "lens" and $kind = "note"
  let islens = "no" otherwise
  let isdoc = "yes" when ($role or "") = "doc"
  let isdoc = "no" otherwise
  let using = ($v.with or "")
  head : row
    role viewhead
    title : text "$title"
      role heading
      clamp 2
      share 1
    kind : text "$kind"
      role meta
    pop : text "Pop out"
      role chip
      only when islens = "yes" and using = ""
      on click host window $title
    close : text "×"
      role tool
      on click do unview $v
  openwith : row
    role pins
    only when islens = "no"
    label : text "Open with"
      role meta
    page : text "page"
      role chip
      role chip.on when using = "doc-page" or (using = "" and isdoc = "yes")
      on click when using != "doc-page" do prop $v with=doc-page
    review : text "design-review"
      role chip
      role chip.on when using = "design-review"
      on click when using != "design-review" do prop $v with=design-review
    plain : text "its own look"
      role chip
      role chip.on when using = "" and isdoc = "no"
      only when using != "" or isdoc = "yes"
      on click when using != "" do prop $v with=""
    any : text "$v.with"
      role find
      hint "or a lens by name…"
      lines 1..1
      share 1
      commit enter only
      on edit do prop $v with="$value"
  with : column
    share 1
    only when using != ""
    lens $v.with
  run : column
    share 1
    only when using = "" and islens = "yes"
    lens $title
  doc : column
    share 1
    only when using = "" and islens = "no" and isdoc = "yes"
    lens doc-page
  known : column
    share 1
    only when using = "" and islens = "no" and isdoc = "no" and ($kind = "note" or $kind = "chat" or $kind = "surface")
    lens home-$kind
  plain : column
    share 1
    scroll scroll
    only when using = "" and islens = "no" and isdoc = "no" and $kind != "note" and $kind != "chat" and $kind != "surface"
    facts : text "status $status · owner $owner · asked by $asked_by"
      role meta
      only when ($status or "") != ""
    next : text "Next: $next"
      role meta
      marks
      only when ($next or "") != ""
    words : text "$text"
      role prose
      marks
a6194:
# view <id>: open it in your home base's viewer (the middle, beside JEFF's chat), with Back to what was open before (a6109).
# Every name the home base draws for an id presses this, through `on link do view $value` on the home base's root.
# Pressing what is already open does nothing. JEFF may use it only when Alex asked to be shown something.
# a5994: with nothing open, max() below had nothing to read and the verb refused; the Conversation (a5080)
# is what every viewer lens already reads as 'nothing open', so it stands there first (lines fill one by one)
do prop prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me viewing=a5080 when count(prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me,prop:viewing) = 0
do prop prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me back=$(max($viewing of prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me)) viewing=$1 find="" with="" when count(prop:role=home-view,prop:actor=$me,prop:viewing=$1) = 0
do prop prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,prop:lens=home-viewer shelf=no when count(prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,prop:lens=home-viewer,prop:shelf=yes) > 0
a6782:
# open-found <thing> <viewer> <layout>: a result chosen in the home base's search (a6642, lens home-search) opens in the
# person's viewer; when the viewer already shows something (not the Conversation), it opens as a panel of its own in a
# new column on the chat's side of the tiling (lens home-thing, shows=<thing>), so both stand side by side. The words go.
do create $3 kind=surface title=column layout=column when ($2.viewing or "") != "" and $2.viewing != "a5080" and $2.viewing != $1
do move $new into=$3 at=0 when ($3.pin or "right") = "left" and ($2.viewing or "") != "" and $2.viewing != "a5080" and $2.viewing != $1
do create $new kind=note title="$1.title" role=home-panel actor=$me lens=home-thing shelf=no shows=$1 when ($2.viewing or "") != "" and $2.viewing != "a5080" and $2.viewing != $1
do prop $3 full="" when ($3.full or "") != "" and ($2.viewing or "") != "" and $2.viewing != "a5080" and $2.viewing != $1
do view $1 when ($2.viewing or "") = "" or $2.viewing = "a5080"
do prop $2 find="" when ($2.viewing or "") != "" and $2.viewing != "a5080"
a6790:
# unview <viewer>: close what that home-base viewer shows (Back keeps it), put the person's Viewer panel away, and bring
# their JEFF chat panel out if it was away (a5994, equal footing: the viewer and the chat are panels). The viewer's × and
# the dock's JEFF use it; `view <id>` is its other half and brings the Viewer panel out.
do prop $1 back="$1.viewing" viewing="" with="" when ($1.viewing or "") != ""
do prop prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,prop:lens=home-viewer shelf=yes when count(prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,prop:lens=home-viewer,prop:shelf=no) > 0
do prop prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,prop:lens=jeff-chat shelf=no when count(prop:role=home-panel,prop:actor=$me,prop:lens=jeff-chat,prop:shelf=yes) > 0
